solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Request put in to obtain spare part for car

indicators.note: the request is put in, placed inside the word for obtaining

parts.note: to obtain is to get
to request is to ask

explanation.surface: A motorist asks around for a replacement component for the car.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasket is a seal that a mechanic replaces, a typical engine spare.

clue.text: Agent is so good, turning up as one prepared to talk

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up reads the pieces from bottom to top

parts.note: a rep, representative, is an agent

explanation.surface: A capable agent turns up ready to spill secrets.
explanation.walkthrough: REPISSOG is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A gossiper is someone given to chatter about others, always ready to talk.

clue.text: Night kit's awkward, not loose on the body

indicators.note: awkward means clumsily arranged, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Nightwear is uncomfortable because it clings to the body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkward' rearranges NIGHT KITS.
explanation.definitionFit: Skintight clothing fits closely, clinging to the figure.

clue.text: A head to instruct? Not the head!

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, which is left off

parts.note: to instruct is to teach

explanation.surface: A school seems to need a head teacher, then decides it does not.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not the head' drops T from TEACH.
explanation.definitionFit: Priced 'a head' means per person, so it is the same as apiece.

clue.text: Rome's officials are involved with sport

indicators.note: involved means tangled together, so the letters of the two words are mixed up

explanation.surface: Roman officials take part in sporting events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges ARE plus SPORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Praetors were magistrates of ancient Rome, ranking just below consuls.

clue.text: Sports official overdue? Blow up again!

parts.note: ref is short for referee
late means overdue

explanation.surface: A tardy referee causes an angry outburst.
explanation.definitionFit: To reflate is to inflate once more, as with a tyre or an economy.

clue.text: Dispatch being prompt and efficient

definitions.meaning: a dispatch here is a journey sent out, an organised trip
the quality of speed and promptness in acting

explanation.surface: Sending something off quickly and effectively.
explanation.definitionFit: An expedition is a mission sent forth; expedition also means speed, as in 'with expedition'.

clue.text: This cat with mewl could be unwelcome

indicators.note: the long word could be made from the cat and mewl rearranged together

explanation.surface: A cat's yowling might not be welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer plus MEWL is an anagram of UNWELCOME.
explanation.definitionFit: The ounce is another name for the snow leopard, a large wild feline.

clue.text: Native American woman is keeping husband under

indicators.note: in a down clue the husband sits beneath the other pieces

parts.note: Sal is a woman's name

explanation.surface: An indigenous woman keeps her spouse in subjection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' joins; 'under' places H at the foot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Salish are an indigenous people of the Pacific Northwest.

clue.text: Your uncle being formal?

parts.note: the phrase Bob's your uncle, with Bob given his full formal name

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob's your uncle' is British slang for 'there you are'; formally Bob is Robert.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert is the formal name behind the nickname Bob in the British catchphrase.

clue.text: Thus, when meeting loud female, entertaining enchantress, stop paying attention

indicators.note: meeting means coming up against, so the pieces sit side by side
entertaining a guest means holding them within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: thus can mean so
an enchantress is a witch
F is forte, loud in music

explanation.surface: Someone meets a noisy woman hosting a sorceress and simply tunes out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertaining' puts WITCH inside SOFF, after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: To switch off is an idiom for mentally disengaging, ceasing to listen.

clue.text: Committee dealing with punishment suffering internal revolution

indicators.note: only the inner letters of the word turn around, the outer pair staying put

parts.note: penal means relating to punishment

explanation.surface: A disciplinary committee is undergoing an internal upheaval.
explanation.walkthrough: In PENAL the middle letters ENA are turned to ANE while P and L stay in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A panel is a small group of people convened to judge or advise, a committee.

clue.text: It's not much for you in France to head west

indicators.note: in an across clue heading west means reading right to left

parts.note: French 'à toi' means for you or yours

explanation.surface: A small gesture for you in France before setting off west.
explanation.walkthrough: À TOI reads backwards as IOTA.
explanation.definitionFit: An iota is the smallest Greek letter, used idiomatically for a tiny amount.

clue.text: Large dress looks silly, no matter what

indicators.note: something that looks silly is in a ridiculous state, so the letters are put in disorder

explanation.surface: Someone wears an oversized frock that looks foolish, whatever anyone says.
explanation.walkthrough: 'looks silly' rearranges LARGE plus DRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Regardless as an adverb means in spite of everything, whatever happens.

clue.text: Boat we're sailing round with sailors in? It must be this

indicators.note: the sailors are placed inside the rearranged letters
sailing suggests movement, so the letters drift into a new order

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A boat crewed by sailors must naturally float on water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sailing' rearranges BOAT WERE, with RN put 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat on water is waterborne, carried along by water.

clue.text: Securely fix engineer on timber structure?

parts.note: a raft is a floating platform of logs

explanation.surface: An engineer bolts something firmly onto a wooden framework.
explanation.definitionFit: To engraft is to graft or implant firmly, fixing one thing into another.

clue.text: "Bravest heroine" includes this OT female

indicators.note: the quoted phrase contains the name within its run of letters

explanation.surface: A quotation praising a courageous Old Testament heroine.
explanation.walkthrough: The name sits across 'bravest heroine'.
explanation.definitionFit: Esther is the Jewish queen of Persia whose book is in the Old Testament.

clue.text: Fanciful seraph outside church, one found in Greek diocese

definitions.note: singular in the clue, while the answer is the plural of the word

indicators.note: fanciful means imaginative, so the letters are freely rearranged

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An imaginary angel hovers outside a church in a Greek see.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' and 'found in' cannot be followed letter by letter, since the angel's H falls between the church's two letters, so 'Fanciful' in effect mixes all three pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: An eparchy is a diocese of the Eastern Orthodox church; the answer is its plural.

clue.text: Sent a communication to military room: Getting on

parts.note: a mess is where service personnel eat
getting on means growing old

explanation.surface: Someone sent a note to the officers' dining hall about ageing.
explanation.definitionFit: Messaged means sent a text or note to someone.

clue.text: Son takes long journey, including a run

indicators.note: the long journey holds the article within it

parts.note: a trek is an arduous long journey

explanation.surface: A son sets off on a hike that includes a jog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'including' puts A into TREK, after S.
explanation.definitionFit: A streak is a run of consecutive wins or losses, an unbroken sequence.

clue.text: Little bird in fireplace grabbed by knight

indicators.note: the fireplace is seized and held within the knight

parts.note: an ingle is a hearth or fireside

explanation.surface: A small bird at the hearth is caught by a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: Knight is usually K or N in crosswords; here it is the fuller abbreviation Kt.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinglets are tiny songbirds such as the goldcrest.

clue.text: Non-religious member of university, an originator of Erastianism

parts.note: a prof, professor, is a university staff member

indicators.note: the originator of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A secular academic who first devised Erastianism, the doctrine of state over church.
explanation.walkthrough: Erastianism holds that the state should rule the church, apt for a secular-minded don.
explanation.definitionFit: Profane means secular, not sacred, the opposite of holy.

clue.text: Very fast river — relax diving into it

indicators.note: the relaxing word plunges inside the river

parts.note: the Po is the river of northern Italy
to rest is to relax

explanation.surface: A rapid river, where people unwind by diving in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' points back to the river, so the relaxing goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Presto is the musical direction for a very quick tempo.

clue.text: Girl is quiet when meeting a boy

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
Ron is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A girl falls silent when she encounters a boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharon is a woman's first name.

clue.text: The fellow will bow before the Queen 2 — a wet creature

indicators.note: the bow comes ahead of the queen in the order of pieces

parts.note: he'll is the contraction of he will
to bow is to bend
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is how Elizabeth II signed

explanation.surface: A man will kneel to Elizabeth II, the damp beast nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: '2' is the numeral in Elizabeth II, whose cipher was ER.
explanation.definitionFit: The hellbender is a giant North American salamander living in streams.

clue.text: Fruit tree in public highway

indicators.note: the tree is held within the letters of the phrase

explanation.surface: A fruit tree growing on the open road.
explanation.definitionFit: The lichi, or lychee, is a Chinese tree bearing sweet fruit.

clue.text: Book of information unopened

indicators.note: unopened means the opening letter is not there

parts.note: facts are information

explanation.surface: A volume of data still lying unopened on the shelf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unopened' drops F from FACTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Acts is the New Testament book, the Acts of the Apostles.

clue.text: Lake found during summer excursion

indicators.note: the lake is found partway through the run of letters

explanation.surface: A lake discovered on a summer outing.
explanation.definitionFit: A mere is a poetic or regional word for a small lake or pond.

clue.text: Kitchen item, last thing needed by your cake decorator

indicators.note: the last thing of a word is its final letter

parts.note: an icer puts icing on cakes

explanation.surface: A baker's decorator needs one final kitchen tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A ricer is a kitchen tool that presses cooked potato into rice-like strands.

clue.text: Machine, something circular getting foamy

parts.note: a lathe is a machine for turning wood or metal
a ring is round

explanation.surface: A spinning machine and a round object start to froth.
explanation.definitionFit: Lathering means producing suds, as soap does when worked with water.

clue.text: Bit of food cooked on site, served with tea mostly

indicators.note: cooked as in cooked up, made over, so the letters are rearranged
most of the word, its last letter dropped

explanation.surface: A snack prepared on location, accompanied by most of a cup of tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges ON SITE to NOISET; 'mostly' cuts TEA to TE.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisette is a small round piece of meat, such as lamb, served as a portion.

clue.text: Being made fun of lessened after time

indicators.note: the lessened word follows the abbreviation for time

parts.note: eased means lessened

explanation.surface: Mockery that has eased off after a while.
explanation.definitionFit: Teased means mocked playfully, a synonym for being ribbed.
